disposition: Accepted V2 difference per PD-2026-08-28-02: C#/.NET is the only supported client and the network path is typed TBEP over QUIC/TLS and UDS, so the V1 HTTP command wire (RequestExecutor, URL/query/body/raft-header contract) is not the V2 surface; the replacement typed-command seam exists and is tested (the C# client drives the real engine across a restart, and every registry operation carries a parity mapping). The workspace sweep docs/parity/ps-04-transfer-adapters-sweep.md proposed the same exclusion (PD-2026-08-26-10 D4), but it is not yet frozen in parity/adjudications.json, so the disposition should be recorded there.
